text:
Lake Kawaguchi is about 20 km around, so half a day by bike is one stretch of shore and lunch, not the whole lake. Pick the ride by the train you take home 👇

🤔 Guess first, then check the answer 👉 https://japanbystation.com/lake-kawaguchi-half-day-cycling

🚲 A · SHORT RIDE (for the 14:58 train)

💴 Q-BIKE, Fujikyu Railway's bike share, is ¥1,100 per hour in its app, capped at ¥3,300 a day. Two hours: ¥2,200.

🌉 Ride to the Kawaguchiko Ohashi Bridge and Ubuyagasaki, about 1.6 km from the station in a straight line, both Fuji viewpoints. We'd be back by about 13:00, then lunch.

🚴 B · NORTH SHORE (for the 16:48 train)

🗻 Oishi Park is about 3.4 km away in a straight line, on the side where Fuji's whole ridge shows.

🍲 Hoto Fudo's north main store is open 11:00–19:00, every day, per Yamanashi's tourism site.

🎫 The paper day pass at the station is ¥4,400, from 10:00, and the bike must be back by 17:00.

🚌 C · SKIP THE BIKE

⏱️ The Red Line bus reaches Oishi Park in 27 minutes, every 15 minutes, ¥1,500 for a day pass. The 14:12 back gets you to the station at 14:39.

✅ OUR TAKE

On an early train home, ride the short stretch. With the 16:48, ride the north shore. Windy, wet or rushed? The bus, plus a walk along the lakeside promenade.
